_comment: PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS.md §4: whether a new message (not my own) in one of my conversations notifies me. The server's PushPlanner (handle + select_recipients) and the three clients' in-app / OS notifications follow the same rule; each case is one message seen by `me`, before the checks every side does on its own (DND, read already, looking at it now). level: the conversation's resolved level (its own, else from the overall setting). reply: "none" = a top-level message, "thread_only" = a reply only in its thread, "also_in_channel" = a reply also sent to the channel. follower: I am in the reply's parent_thread.participant_ids (thread_follows.following: the parent's author, repliers, people mentioned in the thread, follows by hand). unfollowed: I unfollowed the thread by hand (a reply only in it never notifies me then, not even a mention; clients infer it from a mention or keyword hit that did not make me a follower, since those auto-follow everyone else). mentioned: my id in mentioned_user_ids (by name or group). mention_all: @channel / @here. keyword: one of my notify_keywords is in the body.

Same fields as the cases above plus type. Read by the server and Desktop since M88, by iOS and Android from M89 (kept apart from `cases` so their older tests still pass).
